title: My Friend Ali
text:
My friend Ali is very kind. He is always happy to help me with my homework. He is also funny, and he makes everyone laugh.

Ali is not very quiet. He talks a lot in class. Sometimes he is a little lazy in the morning, but he is never angry. I like him very much.

questions.text: What is Ali always happy to do?
What does Ali do in class?
What kind of person is Ali?
How does the writer feel about Ali?
options: The writer is afraid of Ali
The writer does not know Ali
The writer is angry with Ali

vocabulary.definition: friendly and caring toward other people
does not want to work or be active

paragraph_translations: Arkadaşım Ali çok naziktir. Her zaman ödevimde bana yardım etmekten mutluluk duyar. Ayrıca komiktir ve herkesi güldürür.
Ali çok sessiz değildir. Derste çok konuşur. Bazen sabahları biraz tembeldir, ama asla kızgın olmaz. Onu çok severim.
